tools.name: control_room_devices
tools.description: 在一次事务中设置空调电源、目标温度和/或灯光。无人离场收尾时可同时关闭灯和空调。

tools.name: create_or_update_reservation
tools.description: 创建或更新房间使用预约，并指定预冷提前量。

precool_minutes.description: 提前开启空调的分钟数

tools.name: cancel_reservation
tools.description: 取消当前明确的房间预约。

tools.name: update_room_policy
tools.description: 更新舒适温度、日常办公时段、预冷提前量或离场宽限。

tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Get the current weather for a city.

city.description: City name as a standalone value

tools.name: set_lights
tools.description: Set a room's lights to a brightness level 0-100.

tools.name: lookup_price
tools.description: Look up a unit price times quantity.

tools.name: quote_item
tools.description: Look up a unit price times quantity.

tools.name: invoice
tools.description: Extract vendor invoice fields from unstructured text.

tools.name: go_to
tools.description: Walk to a named place in the home scene.

tools.name: order_food
tools.description: Place a food order. Legal pairs: 兰州拉面+牛肉面, 麦当劳+巨无霸.

tools.name: set_lamps
tools.description: 设置房间灯具亮度（与 set_lights 近邻）。

tools.name: set_light_mode
tools.description: 只切换灯光模式，不改亮度。

tools.name: get_weather_forecast
tools.description: 查询未来天气预报，不是当前实况。

tools.name: control_room_hvac
tools.description: 只控制暖通，不控制灯光。

tools.name: create_meeting
tools.description: 创建会议预约（相对房间预约的近邻）。

tools.name: cancel_meeting
tools.description: 取消会议，不是取消房间预约。

tools.name: check_stock
tools.description: 按 SKU 查库存余量。

tools.name: set_switch_level
tools.description: 设置开关档位而不是通断。

tools.name: set_thermostat
tools.description: 设置恒温器，不是瞬时温度。
